text: Iris (People Ops): Quick thought  let's make "mini laminated spot certificates" (business-card size) teams can hand out for micro-recognition. low-cost, reusable, displayable on desks/fridges. volunteers to pilot? :sparkles: Noah (Design): neat! we can design a front template with space for name + 1-line note and a tiny sticker slot. I can do 2 options (fun + formal). Priya (People Ops): love tactile tokens. policy check: taxable if value > $100/yr. Are these considered gifts or swag? Dana (Facilities): we can set up a small laminator station near mailroom for folks to laminate on demand. also provide a sealed pouch for desk placement. Iris (People Ops): cost estimate: cardstock $0.15 each, lamination pouch $0.10, stickers $0.05 -> approx $0.30 per unit plus one-time laminator $45 (we have one spare). target pilot 300 units -> $90 + materials. Liam (Finance): sounds fine under program budget GL 4102. keep receipts and track under petty spend. Iris (People Ops): do we need to log recipients in the recognition portal for payroll reporting? recognition-bot: Reminder  record any non-cash awards via /recognize with #mini-cert tag so they appear in monthly exports. Priya (People Ops): yes please. we'll require managers or peers to submit the quick form when issuing a mini-cert so the record exists. Dana (Facilities): agree on laminator location. accessibility: we'll have pre-laminated blank stock so folks can write before or after lamination if they prefer. Noah (Design): mockups ready by Friday. question: do we put a serial code on each certificate so we can reconcile physical distribution to portal entries? Iris (People Ops): serial code is a good idea but adds process. alternative: require the issuer to scan a QR on a sticker that marks the certificate as given (quick form). recognition-bot: Note  QR-coded issuance forms will create a record and attach tag #mini-cert for export. Liam (Finance): QR form approach fine. tax note: still non-taxable while <$10/yr. if same recipient gets many, payroll flags may apply; portal will flag totals. Priya (People Ops): logistics: pilot week July 10-14, we make 300 blanks and 100 pre-laminated ones. volunteers to staff a 2-hour pop-up laminate desk? Dana can cover setup. Iris (People Ops): volunteers: Priya 12-2 Tue, Noah 12-1 Wed for design touch-ups, Dana 11-1 Thur for teardown. Liam will confirm petty spend. Noah (Design): also propose a small instructional sign: "How it works: 1) write 1-line shoutout 2) scan QR + fill form 3) laminate or take pre-laminated 4) place on desk or give to peer" Priya (People Ops): add privacy blurb: addresses not needed. this is an internal handout only. Iris (People Ops): action items: Noah final mockups; Dana reserve laminator space; Liam confirm petty spend path; Priya build quick QR form; I'll order materials and make signage. recognition-bot: Note  any entries tagged #mini-cert will be included in the July recognition export for payroll review. Liam (Finance): please keep aggregated spend under $500 to avoid formal approval. Iris (People Ops): thanks everyone  pilot sounds low-friction. excited to see desks get colorful. :tada:
